Aditya / team — pulling together the latency write-up now. A couple of notes to align expectations:

- Root cause: the P95 bump correlates with a shift in request-length distribution on 16 Jul (more long-context requests) and a temporary kernel scheduling regressions we observed after the runtime patch. Mitigation path: 1) revert the kernel scheduling tweak (hotfix) or 2) apply an adaptive batching cap for affected routes.
- I'll include a short appendix that explains prefix/KV cache behavior (two lines) and a simple graph showing per-route percentiles.
- Timeline update: I can do the initial draft by Tue morning (24 Jul 09:00), final by Tue EOD if no blockers. Is Tue morning OK for Lauren to consume for slide prep?

Also: for cost knobs, Aditya, I'll validate the latency trade-offs for a 4-bit quantization experiment and give an estimated token-cost delta by Wed noon.

On quoting Aditya: "Please treat this as the canonical tracker for follow-ups; reply with updates in-thread." Will keep everything in-thread.

Thanks,
